title: Synthetic offline security assessment
author: Training analyst
authorization: Training exercise on the supplied synthetic log only. No real host, network or person is being assessed.
summary: One demonstration observation. This is not a completed assessment of a real system.

evidence.description: Explicitly synthetic training log; no personal information or credentials.

findings.title: Failed-login count warrants review in the exercise
findings.observation: The synthetic log states that seven logins failed. It contains no evidence of a successful unauthorised login.
findings.impact: No actual compromise is established. In an authorised real assessment, repeated failures may warrant further investigation.
findings.recommendation: In the disposable lab, inspect the authentication configuration and additional evidence before drawing conclusions.
